$comment: USD per 1M tokens, consumed by src/Experiment/CostMeter.ts.
A model with null prices is treated as UNPRICED, not free: CostMeter records its token
counts, leaves costUsd null, and reports the model in `unpricedModels` so the run card
and bin/evaluate.ts can flag it rather than silently under-reporting spend.
Verification item 11 of the refactor plan requires comparing the meter's total against the
provider dashboard once. Fill in any null below from the dashboard before trusting a $ figure.
Anthropic prices are first-party API list rates; Bedrock/Vertex-brokered Claude differs.

models.$comment_local: Self-hosted via Ollama: no marginal API cost. Wall-clock is still metered.

providerDefaults.$comment: Fallback when a model id is absent from `models`. Only ollama has a defensible default (local inference is free at the margin); cloud providers stay unpriced so a missing entry is visible rather than assumed.
